title: Understanding Constant Models
text: When considering a constant model, think about how the mean and median of a dataset relate to minimizing errors. Which one is more sensitive to outliers?

title: Exploring MSE and MAE
text: Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) are both measures of prediction accuracy. Consider how each measure reacts to large errors. Which one squares the errors?

title: Choosing the Optimal Constant for MAE
text: If you want to minimize the Mean Absolute Error (MAE), which central tendency measure should you consider?

title: Choosing the Optimal Constant for MSE
text: To minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE), which central tendency measure is typically used?

title: Multiple Optimal Constants for MAE
text: Consider a dataset with an even number of data points. How might the median be represented in such a case? Could there be more than one value that minimizes the MAE?
